_comment: The libgit2 wrap campaign's order of modules, waves and batches, as planner run 3 re-planned it
whole: every earlier wave (0-523, translation and review, done, wip and todo) is removed and the
landed items are scheduled again where the order places them, waves 524 on. modules and waves
come from one wavefront schedule of crustify/wavefront/configs/wavefront-config.json
(--api-headers-only, the workload caps: max-types 2, min-fields 20, max-syms 25, max-loc 500),
its modules by layer and its waves in its order, renumbered from 524; enums are left to their
-sys definitions. Three departures from that schedule: the deprecated callback git_url_resolve_cb
and the GIT_DEPRECATE_HARD-only field variants (commit_id of git_attr_options, git_blob_filter_options
and git_filter_options, git_rebase_options.signing_cb, git_remote_callbacks.resolve_url and
update_tips), which the traced tests and CLI compile but the configured library does not, are out
of scope; src/util/alloc.c's wave also holds its allocator family (git__malloc, git__calloc,
git__mallocarray, git__free, git__strdup, git__strndup, git__substrdup), the type-erased and string
strategies the bindings release owned fields through, which no public signature reaches; and a
unit a wave reaches through a cut of another module ordered later is wrapped, with its
public-signature closure, in a wave of its own module listed just before that wave (19 such waves).
A wave's depends_on is recomputed from its items' unit edges: scheduled, its module's previous
wave and the earlier waves holding its items' dependencies; cut, the later waves holding them, a
cut within the module, or the one the git_remote_callbacks/git_transport cycle leaves (wave 664
reaches remote.c's 668). modules[*].depends_on keeps wavefront's module-level records; no unit's
public signature reaches an out-of-tree library, so every external list is empty. Every wave and
batch is todo with empty commits: the assistant marks the landed part done and attributes its
commits. Homes follow the conventions: src/libgit2/<TU path>.rs, a header module's <stem>_h.rs.
